changelog.title: NEW SYNERGIES
changelog.body:
Spiked Carapace now hits back with 15 melee damage, and the host's on-hit trinkets (Flame, Poison, Shock...) land on whoever attacked it.
Shatter now deals its bonus damage to cards with 10 or more Frost, not only to Frozen cards.

changelog.title: CLEARER AT LOWER RESOLUTIONS
changelog.body: Cards, tablet screens and text on the table now look sharper and easier to read at lower screen resolutions.

changelog.title: BOT AND STARTER PACK CHANGES
changelog.body:
Bots no longer get a free summon now and then. They are given a Reinforcements card instead.
The first and final starter packs of the campaign have been rebalanced.

changelog.title: SHOP AND BOOSTER PACK ANIMATIONS
changelog.body: Buying from the shop and opening booster packs now play new animations and card glow effects.

changelog.title: STORY EXPANSION
changelog.body:
The story continues with a new act, new side missions and a lot more dialogue. The Lore tab has been rewritten to match.
The campaign map and battle scenes have also had some changes.

changelog.title: PERFORMANCE
changelog.body: Battles run smoother, especially with lots of cards, glows and status effects on the table.

changelog.title: MY DECK, REMANTLER AND SMELTER
changelog.body:
My Deck now groups your cards into Units, Spells and Trinkets and shows six cards to a row. Bars under IN YOUR DECK show how full your deck and trinkets are, and the tab counts now count every copy.
A hint along the bottom explains it: click a card to move one copy between your deck and storage, right-click to inspect it.
The Remantler and Smelter also show six cards to a row.

changelog.title: MENU TIDY-UP
changelog.body:
Every section of the menu now has its own colour, and tabs, buttons and pop-ups look the same on every page. Buttons that move you on are green, and buttons that delete something are red.
Options and Profile now have a background, and the panels on the Multiplayer pages now show properly over their background picture.
Replay Tutorial is now on the Profile > Stats page. The Missions page no longer shows a note about runs, which gives the missions more room.
